title: Image-to-LoRA V2 collection became a public project milestone
summary: On 2026-06-17, the Image-to-LoRA development line was associated with a public ModelScope collection for Image-to-LoRA V2. This is a material version-level milestone because it identifies a concrete public distribution point for the project at that date. The available evidence does not establish the model's technical changes, authorship, or release status beyond that linked collection.
